title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Mobile - Sênior (Flutter)
description:
O que você precisa para essa posição:


Formação Acadêmica

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou experiência prática equivalente.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar na construção de uma arquitetura mobile escalável e de fácil entendimento;
  • Atuar na identificação e correção de bugs e comportamentos não desejáveis;
  • Acompanhar de forma ativa a saúde das aplicações mobile utilizando-se de métricas e relatórios;
  • Colaborar de forma ativa junto às squads no planejamento, desenvolvimento e entrega de novas funcionalidades;
  • Escrever cenários de testes automatizados buscando uma cobertura de testes ampla e confiável;
  • Trabalhar de forma contínua na identificação de melhorias e otimizações de performance;
  • Zelar pela qualidade das aplicações mobile junto às lojas;
  • Zelar pela segurança das aplicações mobile.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando Flutter;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicativos nativos (Android com Kotlin/Java e/ou iOS com Swift/Obj-C) ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos utilizando gestão de estados no padrão Bloc ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em desenvolvimento de aplicativos com Arquitetura Limpa ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em testes unitários, integração, instrumentados e E2E ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos modulares/multi-lib ;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de design systems ;
  • Experiência com diferentes Arquiteturas e Padrões de Projetos;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com análise e monitoramento de erros de aplicativos em produção ;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com processo de releases nas lojas de aplicativos Google Play/Apple Store;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos com desenvolvimento e automação de esteiras de delivery .


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com frameworks e padrões de segurança, como OWASP, NIST, ISO/IEC 27001 e em programa de Security Champions.


E aí curtiu?

Inscreva-se e faça parte do nosso time!

title: Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior
description:
Sobre a Empresa:

O Clínica Experts é uma plataforma completa de gestão para clínicas de saúde, estética e bem-estar, utilizada diariamente por mais de 7.500 clínicas e 16.000 usuários. Entregamos soluções que integram agenda, prontuário, financeiro, estoque, comunicação omnichannel e inteligência artificial, garantindo eficiência e escala para operações de todos os portes.


Sobre a Oportunidade:

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior para atuar diretamente no squad de IA do Clínica Experts, responsável por projetar, evoluir e escalar soluções baseadas em LLMs, agentes inteligentes e sistemas multi-agentes.

Você trabalhará em desafios reais de produção, com alto volume de dados e usuários, construindo soluções que vão desde engenharia de prompts até arquiteturas complexas de agentes com supervisão, memória, ferramentas e observabilidade.


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Arquitetar e desenvolver soluções de IA baseadas em LLMs para ambientes de produção em larga escala;
  • Projetar e implementar sistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
  • Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
  • Atuar na definição de estratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
  • Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
  • Participar ativamente da inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
  • Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.


Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
  • Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
  • LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
  • LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
  • Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
  • Integração com APIs de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
  • Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
  • Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
  • Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
  • Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.


Você vai se divertir mais se:

  • Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
  • Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
  • Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
  • Tiver senso de dono e se preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.


Será um diferencial se você:

  • Tiver experiência com Node.js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
  • Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
  • Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
  • Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
  • Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
  • Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - Desenvolvimento Java
description:
Banco de Talentos | Desenvolvimento Java


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de Desenvolvimento Java , em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead ), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, ambientes de alta performance e contextos tecnológicos inovadores.


Se você busca oportunidades para evoluir sua carreira e trabalhar com tecnologias modernas, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações em Java;
  • Participar da construção de soluções escaláveis e de alta performance;

title: Senior Rust Engineer (Relocation to Munich)
description:
Senior Rust Engineer


Low Latency | Async Rust | Tokio


Salary: 90,000 - 105,000


On-site | Munich


We have a new and exclusive partnership with one of the most exciting scale-ups in Europe, who are looking to double in size their engineering team. They have a valuation exceeding 2 billion Euros.


The company builds aerial intelligence hardware and software. They're main focus is the manufacturing of UAV's. Alongside this, they are also developing bleeding edge software that provides actionable insights in defense, security and professional services.


The Rust Team:


This engineering team are focusing on building a greenfield command and control center, designed specifically for unmanned systems.


What you'll be doing:


  • Architect, build, and support reliable, high-performance systems for coordinating swarms and handling sensor data.
  • Develop streamlined communication methods and real-time data processing tools tailored for robotic platforms.
  • Work hand-in-hand with multidisciplinary teams to connect backend infrastructure with robotic applications and sensor arrays.
  • Enhance overall system efficiency, expandability, and dependability within distributed robotic setups.


Experience you'll need:


  • Production experience with Rust , or contributions to production grade open source repos. 2+ Years.
  • Experience working with Tokio , or other asynchronous frameworks such as async.std or Smol.
  • Ideally a background in a core programming language such as C, C++, or Core Java. Candidates from functional backgrounds such as Scala, Erlang or Clojure are also encouraged to apply.
  • Experience developing low-latency, high throughput systems.


Nice to have:

  • Experience working with drones or robotics
  • experience working with microcontrollers


This is an excellent opportunity to join one of the most rapidly scaling companies in Europe, that are developing truly cutting edge software and hardware.

title: Consultor SAP ABAP/CPI
description:
A Softtek está em busca de um(a) Consultor SAP ABAP/PO/CPI Sênior para fazer parte do nosso time e Atuar no AMS com atendimento de incidentes e melhorias de diversos clientes.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento e experiência na tecnologia SAP PI/PO/CPI;
  • Experiência com múltiplos padrões (Cloud-to-Cloud, Cloud-to-On-Premise) e adapters (HTTP, File, RFC, OData, SOAP, IDOC, SFTP, REST).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura, monitoramento, troubleshooting e administração de interfaces em geral;
  • Experiência com Groovy Script para customizações e validações.
  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção de iFlows.
  • Vivência em SAP GRC/DRC (NF-e, CT-e, MDF-e).
  • Vivência em segurança em integrações (certificados, OAuth2, Basic Auth, TLS).
  • Necessidade de ter conhecimento sobre o conector SAP Cloud;
  • Conhecimento em Design Iflow e desenvolvimento em SAP CPI;
  • Diferencial ter vivência em cenários com SuccessFactors, Salesforce, Ariba, Concur...;
  • Conhecimentos em BTP: API Management, Event Mesh e Integration Advisor.
  • Conhecimentos consolidado em ABAP: Dicionário de dados(tabelas ,visões, elementos de dados, domínios... ) de relatório (ALV; ALV OO), programas de carga e extração (Batch input, bapi), interfaces.
  • Criação e manutenção de Funções/RFC, Includes;
  • Criação e manutenção Sapscript e Smartforms;
  • Aplicação de notas SAP;
  • Dialog Programs: criação e manutenção de telas para entradas de dados (Online);
  • Enhancements: criação e manutenção de user-exits (Menu, Screen, Function module, etc), extensão de objetos do dicionário de dados;
  • Conhecimento BADIs, regra de subistituição e validação para o módulo de FI.
  • Experiência em ABAP proxy (SPROXY/SOAMANAGER);

title: Scrum Master
description:
Job Description: Scrum Master - Experience 4+ years as Scrum Master Role


Summary: We are seeking a highly driven Scrum Master to lead Agile delivery execution for Azure-based Data and Digital transformation programs.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Facilitate all Agile ceremonies and ensure sprint discipline.
  • Monitor sprint velocity, capacity, and progress.
  • Ensure Jira governance, compliance, and reporting.
  • Identify and manage risks, dependencies, and blockers.
  • Drive delivery predictability and continuous improvement.
  • Provide clear stakeholder communication and reporting.
  • Coordinate across cross-functional teams and squads.

Required Skills & Qualifications:


  • Strong hands-on experience with Jira and Azure DevOps.
  • Deep understanding of Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe).
  • Experience working in Data / Cloud / Azure programs, including exposure to platforms such as Databricks Strong understanding of SDLC and DevOps lifecycle.

title: Citrix Engineer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 4 years as a Citrix Engineer ;
  • Experience with Citrix Legacy (produts);
  • Knowledge of Citrix Cloud;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: 1st Level Tech Support Agent
description:
Bookmap is a market depth visualisation and high-speed trading platform, providing complete market transparency and incomparable insight into the actions and intentions of equities, futures, and crypto traders.

Built to help traders make informed decisions, gain competitive advantage, and ensure consistent success, it has become the industry-leading software for order book and order flow analysis.


We are currently looking to hire a 1st Level Tech Support Agent , to join our growing team and cover US time zones.


Responsibilities


This role is 100% remote and includes shifts


As a 1st level customer support agent, your tasks will focus on looking after, supporting and advising our international customers from the crypto/stocks/futures trading environment.


You will receive functional and technical inquiries and faults via the live chat, by e-mail and occasionally by telephone, process them independently or forward them to the right contact person conscientiously.


Required skills and experience

  • Background in Computer Science, Economics, Finance or other related field
  • Experience in the area of customer support, ideally for software products
  • Technical interest in complex software is desirable
  • Good command of the English language, both written and verbal
  • Solution-oriented
  • Structured way of working 
  • Team spirit
  • Commitment


The below would be considered an advantage

  • Interest or experience in trading financial instruments(crypto, futures, etc)
  • A second foreign language


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Paid annual leave and sick leave
  • Equipment and software reimbursement, with flexible options to suit your needs
  • Opportunities for professional development, including language courses and training programs
  • A collaborative, international team and a supportive work culture


The hiring process consists of 3 steps:

1.After applying, successful candidates will be asked to answer a short questionnaire

2.Those who pass the first stage will be required to complete a paid test task

3. Interview with our team

title: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo

NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.

NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.

We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.

Role and responsibilities

The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.

title: Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)
description:
Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel)


Location: Brazil


Please send your resume in English!


Our trusted high-growth healthcare technology partner is seeking a talented Backend Team Lead (PHP/Laravel) to join their dynamic team. This innovative company is dedicated to revolutionizing the healthcare industry through cutting-edge technology solutions.


Position Overview


As a Backend Team Lead , you will play a key role in leading the backend development team while contributing to the development and implementation of scalable and robust software solutions that support the company's mission and goals. You will guide and support the backend team while working closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities


  • Team Leadership:

Lead and support the backend engineering team, ensuring effective collaboration, task distribution, and delivery of high-quality software.

  • Platform Development:

Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel , ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Database Development:

Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes.

  • API Development and Integration:

Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.

  • Security Compliance:

Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA , by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities


  • Mentor backend developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Support the team in resolving technical challenges and ensure consistent development standards across the team.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in an agile development environment, contributing to team coordination and iterative delivery processes, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.


Competencies / Requirements


  • Technical Expertise:

Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL . Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git .

  • Experience:

At least 6+ years of experience in backend development , with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Previous experience leading or mentoring developers is required. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.

  • Problem-Solving Skills:

Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.

  • Communication Skills:

Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.

  • Attention to Detail:

A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

title: Senior Angular Developer (Angular and Electron)
description:
At Intellias , we're always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our team in Colombia. Over 20 years of market experience, Intellias brings together technologists, creators and innovators in Europe, North and Latin America, and the Middle East. Join our international team and take the mission to solve the advanced tech challenges of tomorrow!


If you're enthusiastic about contributing your skills and experience to our organization, we invite you to submit your CV for this position.


What we offer you in Intellias

  • B2B Contract
  • Fixed hour-based salary. You should have a private entrepreneurs (PE) and open US dollar bank account.
  • Corporate courses (Udemy, LinkedIn Learning and O'Raily)
  • Technical equipment on request
  • 100% English environment


Requirements:


  • English B2/C1
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development
  • Highly Proficient in Angular 20, TypeScript, JavaScript, ES8+, HTML5, CSS3.
  • Proficient in test-driven development, automated testing, and the use of testing frameworks
  • Experience with Less/Sass CSS Pre-processors
  • Experience in the area of modular and scalable software development
  • Experience maintaining a living and complex codebase with a modern stack
  • Designing and developing reusable, testable front end components
  • Desire to learn cutting edge technology to solve complex business problems
  • Experience with Electron, Webpack, NodeJS, Vue.js, NPM, SVG


Responsabilities


  • Develop and maintain modern web solutions as a Senior Engineer within the Web Team using Angular 18, JavaScript, TypeScript (ES8+), HTML5, and CSS3 .
  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable UI components for web and desktop platforms, including Web, Windows, and macOS applications.
  • Establish and uphold high‑quality, maintainable, and performant coding standards , ensuring consistency across multiple platforms.
  • Collaborate closely with backend engineers, QA teams, and UX designers to deliver new features and enhancements for next‑generation applications.
  • Contribute to architecture design, technical decisions, design patterns, and development best practices .
  • Mentor and support engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and knowledge sharing .
  • Drive continuous improvement in frontend architecture, performance, and user experience .
  • Own features from concept and design through implementation and delivery , ensuring alignment with both business and technical goals .

title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Senior Business Analyst (Healthcare Marketing)
description:
One of our clients, a USA Healthcare Commercialization firm, is looking for a Senior Business Analyst with experience in SOWs and Project Finance. This role would be focused on their Speaker Bureau operations (organization of medical conferences and congresses).


The Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for managing financial and operational aspects of assigned clients and their products. This role requires a high level of understanding of the assigned clients and products, various speaker bureau project types, and the ability to work independently.


The Sr. Business Analyst works closely with the Director and financial analysts to ensure accurate internal and external financial reporting, develop budget proposals and provide financial related support in client meetings.


Financial


● Oversee day-to-day financial operations for speaker bureau, including budget tracking, internal revenue accruals, forecasting and variance analysis.

● Develops Statement of Work (SOW), ensuring final sign-off by Director as required.

● Create and manage budgets and proposals, providing oversight for complex SOWs. Prepare speaker bureau specific budgets, accrual reports and monthly financial management updates

● Work closely with program directors on monthly accrual reports, reviewing and discussing as needed.

● Ensure accuracy in financial reconciliation data before releasing reports to clients

● Generate and distribute monthly accruals and budget reports for clients

● Provide invoicing amounts to Accounts Receivable to facilitate timely invoice submissions


Operational


● Ensures compliance with internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and client specific SOPs.

● Provides budget related support in client meetings as needed.

● Participates in accrual meetings with clients based on their SOPs.

● Contributes to process improvement initiatives to enhance financial operations.


Experience and Skills


● 2+ Years experience in budgeting · Proficiency in Excel functions for financial modeling and analysis.

● Strong financial analysis skills, including budget tracking, forecasting and variance analysis · Excellent understanding of internal SOPs and ability to ensure compliance

● Familiar with all internal and external SOPs.

● Strives to find process efficiencies by thinking outside the box and making recommendations for change.

● Knowledge of ERP systems, NetSuite a plus

● Excellent client facing skills, including comfortability with all types of client communications.

● Prior speaker bureau experience a plus

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Desenvolvedor de back end
description:
Quem Somos?

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.



O que esperar de nós?

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Engenharia de Software SR - Salesforce Marketing Cloud


Descrição da vaga

Você se identifica com a área de Engenharia de Software e possui como propósito ajudar pessoas a construir um time com uma forte cultura de engenharia de software, que agregue cada vez mais valor aos negócios?


#LI-LR1

#LI-REMOTE


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Ser uma referência técnica para os times em que atua, sendo proativo e exercendo a liderança junto ao time, comunicando-se com diferentes papéis e níveis hierárquicos.
  • Propor soluções compatíveis com os desafios técnicos e de negócio.
  • Aplicar e disseminar boas práticas de engenharia de software, alinhada com as diretrizes do time arquitetura.
  • Colaborar com outros times, promovendo alinhamento e comunicação clara.
  • Documentar soluções e decisões técnicas, facilitando o entendimento e evolução das soluções.
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento técnico de outros engenheiros do time.
  • Participar ativamente de processos de Upstream e Downstream em múltiplas Squads, propondo e apoiando para garantir as melhores soluções.
  • Realizar testes integrados E2E, promovendo práticas de qualidade, observabilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Projetar Integrações entre o Marketing Cloud e outros sistemas Backend.
  • Buscar a observabilidade nas jornadas, criando e utilizando métricas, logs e monitoramento para evoluir continuamente a operação.
  • Buscar e aplicar feedbacks para melhoria contínua, mantendo postura colaborativa e proativa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

Experiencia:

  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud;
  • AMPscript e SSJS;
  • Construção de Custom Activity, Jornadas e Automações;
  • Import e Export de dados no Marketing Cloud;
  • Edição de Criativos e scripts;
  • Criação de Data Streams, Data Models, Calculated Insights, Segmentação e Ativação no Salesforce Data Cloud.


Conhecimento:

  • Data Cloud;
  • Modelagem, governança e desenvolvimento Data Cloud e Marketing Cloud;
  • Modelagem de Dados (Entidade e relacionamentos);
  • SQL Avançado;
  • Consumo de APIs;
  • Construção de Cloud Pages;
  • Capacidade de troubleshooting em integrações, automações, APIs e scripts;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de governança de dados, de duplicação e identificação no Data Cloud.


Soft Skills:

  • Capacidade de fazer apresentações para públicos qualificados como Líderes de Produto e de Tecnologia
  • Capacidade de engajar pessoas de negócio e de disciplinas conectadas para a tomada de decisão e evolução do tema;
  • Perfil \"comunicação que aproxima\": Diminuir barreiras, construir pontes e manter alinhamento e transparência nas ações em um ambiente remoto/online;
  • Perfil \"Data-driven\": Tomada de decisão baseada na análise profunda de dados;
  • Perfil \"Vai lá e faz\": sempre que é necessário, coloca a mão na massa e resolve;
  • Liderança;
  • Organização.


Informações adicionais:

No Sicredi você vai ter:


14º e 15º salários fixos;

Participações nos Resultados (conforme a senioridade);

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico sem coparticipação,

Programas de bem-estar com Wellhub (antiga Gympass), Nutrição, Psicologia, Laboral, Massagem, Grupo de corrida e academia local;

Vale Alimentação e Vale Refeição – com flexibilidade de % nos cartões VA/VR, sem coparticipação;

Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;

Auxílio creche ou babá para crianças até 6 anos e 11 meses;

Auxílio para filhos com deficiência, sem limite de idade;

Seguro de vida,

Previdência Privada até 8% do salário;

Plataforma de Treinamentos – Sicredi Aprende, com diversos cursos;

Carga horária de 40h semanais – Utilizando sistema de banco de horas;

Auxílio Teletrabalho (exceto para posições com atuação 100% presenciais).

title: Senior Developer in Spyglass
description:
Senior Developer with primary focus on Spyglass Event Configuration Management


Responsibilities


  • Design and implement Event Correlation Rules within Spyglass to aggregate disparate logs and metrics into meaningful business events;
  • Configure Event Policies Suppression Rules and Deduplication logic to reduce alert fatigue for L1/L2 support teams
  • Build and maintain Spyglass Dashboards that provide real time visibility into the health of the FMCG application landscape
  • Experience Engineering Mobile and Emerging Tech
  • Integrate Spyglass with diverse data sources Azure Monitor GCP Cloud Logging AWS CloudWatch and ELKFalcon LogScale
  • Manage the lifecycle of an event from ingestion and normalization to correlation alerting and archival
  • Proactive Monitoring SRE Integration
  • Develop Thresholdbased and Anomaly detection alerts to identify performance degradation before it impacts the consumer experience
  • Implement Service Level Objective SLO monitoring within Spyglass to track the reliability of critical business paths, eg OrdertoCash, Checkout flows
  • Automate the creation of incidents in ITSM tools, eg ServiceNow, based on Spyglass event triggers
  • Build Situation Rooms or high level executive views within Spyglass for major promotional events or seasonal peaks
  • Ensure seamless event ingestion from hyperscaler hosted microservices AKSGKE and serverless functions
  • Support the monitoring of Integration Platforms Boomi APIM by capturing and correlating middleware execution events
  • Collaborate with the Cloud Infrastructure team to monitor network latency and connectivity events across the global AzureGCP backbone


Senior Developer Specifics

  • Lead the architectural design of the Global Event Management Strategy
  • Define enterprise standards for event metadata severity levels and correlation patterns
  • Mentor junior developers in eventdriven observability and AIOps principles
  • Conduct PostMortem analysis of major incidents to refine Spyglass correlation rules and prevent recurrence


Must have

  • Spyglass Event Management Expert level, proficiency in Spyglass configuration rule writing and dashboarding
  • Event Correlation Deep understanding of event patterns deduplication and suppression logic
  • Observability Integration Hands on experience connecting Spyglass to Azure Monitor, GCP Stackdriver or ELK
  • ITSM Integration
  • Proven experience integrating event platforms with ServiceNow or similar tools
  • Data Normalization, Ability to parse and normalize logs events from heterogeneous sources JSON, XML, Syslog

title: Planejador Financeiro/ Planejador Patrimonial (Pessoa Física)
description:
Se você é ASSESSOR(A) DE INVESTIMENTOS e está em busca de uma transição para CONSULTORIA DE INVESTIMENTOS e PLANEJAMENTO, para poder aumentar seu potencial de remuneração e poder atuar com propósito, colocando o cliente em primeiro lugar de verdade, torne-se um Planejador Financeiro e Patrimonial junto ao Grupo Capital. Aqui você terá treinamentos e mentorias para se desenvolver em duas frentes, a técnica e a comportamental.

Essa vaga é direcionada a assessores que tenham uma carteira ativa de clientes ou tenham uma rede de relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma. 

Se essa oportunidade se alinha ao seu perfil e ao que você busca, inscreva-se! 


Veja mais detalhes sobre o Grupo Capita e a vaga, que terá início em 13/10/25:


O Grupo Capital:


Assessorias, bancos e corretoras costumam bater metas nos clientes, enquanto deveriam bater as metas dos clientes.


Na contra-mão desse modelo, repleto de conflito de interesse, nasce o Grupo Capital, uma organização formada por pessoas que colocam seus clientes verdadeiramente em primeiro lugar.


Além de acesso às melhores soluções do mercado e um método exclusivo, validado por mais de 4 mil clientes, somos associados à Planejar, instituição responsável pelo CFP® no Brasil. 


Com o propósito de conquistar além, somos profissionais comprometidos em fazer a diferença, impulsionando o sucesso e prosperidade de cada indivíduo com quem interagimos.


Seu desenvolvimento junto ao Grupo Capita l:


A evolução da sua carreira é prioridade! Por isso você terá acesso à ferramentas, especialistas certificados, mentores e um programa estruturado de partnership, para que você possa se tornar sócio do Grupo Capital.


Durante o seu onboarding você aprenderá tudo o que precisa sobre a metodologia exclusiva de planejamento financeiro e patrimonial e as habilidades técnicas e comportamentais, sempre envolvendo estudos de caso reais e prática.


Por fim, pedir e dar feedbacks comportamentais, técnicos ou sobre processos, está no nosso dia a dia. Acreditamos que feedbacks de qualidade são a chave para o verdadeiro desenvolvimento.


Responsabilidades:


  • Prospectar, conduzir reuniões, entender o cliente e alinhar expectativas;
  • Coletar todos os dados necessários e realizar a venda do serviço;
  • Revisar o projeto financeiro ou patrimonial personalizado feito para cada cliente;
  • Conduzir reuniões do projeto, apresentando os caminhos/ soluções e tirando dúvidas;
  • Realizar as vendas consultivas necessárias para que os clientes alcancem seus objetivos;
  • Aconselhar de forma adequada os recursos financeiros dos clientes. 


Pré-requisitos:


  • Colocar o cliente em primeiro lugar sempre;
  • Proatividade orientada a resultados;
  • Interesse em receber e dar feedback;
  • Comunicação clara, escuta ativa, carisma e simpatia;
  • Experiência com vendas e Planejamento Financeiro/ Patrimonial ou Investimentos;
  • Carteira ativa de clientes ou relacionamentos alta renda que possibilitem a construção de uma.


Diferencial:


  • Certificação CFP®, CEA, CNPI, CGA, AAI, SUSEP ou pós-graduação em áreas correlatas.


Você terá:


  • Remuneração altamente competitiva e sem teto de ganhos;
  • Desenvolvimento profissional com programa de mentoria individual;
  • Programa de partnership estruturado;
  • Treinamentos exclusivos;
  • Metodologia de atendimento exclusiva e validada;
  • Acesso a um hub completo de soluções financeiras;
  • Suporte de um time de especialistas experientes e certificados;
  • Flexibilidade de horário e liberdade geográfica;
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver novos projetos/ produtos junto ao Grupo Capital;
  • Ambiente amigável, colaborativo e inspirador;
  • Suporte de backoffice e equipe de sucesso do cliente.


Modo de contratação:


  • Primeiros 3 ou 6 meses → Contrato de prestação de serviços
  • Após alcance dos critérios → Associado ao Grupo Capital


Caso você acredite que essa oportunidade se alinha ao que você busca, inscreva-se!

title: Social Media Lead/Community Manager
description:
We’re hiring: Social Lead / Social Media & Community Manager

Earned Media Productions (EMP) is looking for someone who can turn podcasts into growth engines — and build engaged communities around them.

This role sits at the intersection of content distribution, social strategy, and audience engagement.


What you’ll do:

• Own daily posting across TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, and more

• Turn podcast episodes into high-performing short-form content

• Decide what clips get posted, when, and where

• Manage comments, DMs, and community engagement across platforms

• Help shape the voice and presence of brands online

• Analyze performance and double down on what works


Key Responsibilities 1. Content Distribution & Posting
  • Own daily posting across all social platforms (TikTok, IG Reels, YouTube Shorts, X, etc.)
  • Manage scheduling, captions, hashtags, and formatting per platform
  • Ensure consistent, high-volume output of podcast clips
2. Podcast Clip Strategy
  • Turn long-form podcast episodes into a structured content distribution plan
  • Decide what clips get posted, when, and where
  • Collaborate with editors to guide clip selection and packaging (hooks, titles, formats)
3. Growth & Optimization
  • Analyze performance data to identify winning formats, topics, and hooks
  • Continuously iterate on posting strategy to increase:
  • Views
  • Engagement
  • Follower growth
  • A/B test captions, formats, and posting times
4. Platform Expertise
  • Stay on top of trends, algorithm changes, and best practices across platforms
  • Adapt content strategy accordingly (e.g., TikTok vs. Reels vs. Shorts nuances)
5. Systems & Organization
  • Build and manage a content calendar + distribution system
  • Track posted content and performance metrics
  • Ensure no content bottlenecks between editing → posting → reporting
6. Collaboration
  • Work closely with:
  • Editors (to refine clips)
  • Creators/clients (to align on voice and goals)
  • Leadership (to align on growth strategy)


What we’re looking for:

• Experience growing social accounts (especially short-form video)

• Strong understanding of TikTok / Reels / Shorts

• Someone who actually gets internet culture + audience behavior

• Ability to manage both content output + community interaction

Must-Haves
  • 2–4+ years managing social media accounts (preferably podcast or creator-led content)
  • Proven experience growing accounts through short-form video
  • Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
  • Strong instincts for what makes content go viral
  • Experience managing high-volume posting (multiple posts/day)
  • Fluent in English - Speaking and Writing. 
Nice-to-Haves
  • Experience working with podcasts or long-form content
  • Background in content editing or scripting
  • Familiarity with tools like:
  • Asana/ Slack
  • Social schedulers (Later, Hootsuite, etc.)
  • Analytics tools
  • Experience managing multiple brands or clients
Bonus:

• Experience with podcasts or creator-led brands

• Background in content editing or scripting

• Experience building or managing online communities

This is a high-impact role with real ownership across content, distribution, and community.

title: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consultant
description:
Genesis Consulting has an immediate opportunity for an experienced SAP S/4HANA Finance (FI) Consultant to support a global operation S/4HANA. The consultant will play a critical role in the implementation, configuration, and optimization of core financial processes within SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition. Our clients are some of the world’s leading companies and the candidate will be a part of challenging projects to build and support technical solutions for their needs.



The SAP S/4HANA FI Consultant will act as a functional utility player across the Finance workstream, supporting General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Funds Management, and integration with Procurement, Asset Management, and Payroll. The role requires hands-on participation across all phases of the implementation lifecycle, including design, configuration, testing, cutover, and post-go-live support.



The consultant will work closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure financial processes are aligned to SAP S/4HANA best practices while supporting the client’s operational and regulatory requirements. This includes supporting the transition from ECC-based processes to S/4HANA capabilities, including Fiori-enabled user experiences and embedded analytics.



The FI Consultant will also assist in identifying opportunities to streamline legacy processes, reduce customizations, and leverage standard S/4HANA functionality, while ensuring continuity of critical financial operations during the system conversion.



Duties and Responsibilities:


The Consultant facilitates the implementation and support of SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions to enhance the client’s financial operations and overall system performance, while maintaining a high degree of customer satisfaction.


  • Configure and support SAP S/4HANA Finance components including GL, AP, AR, Asset Accounting
  • Participate in fit-to-standard workshops and support design decisions aligned to S/4HANA best practices
  • Act as a cross-functional contributor, supporting integration points between Finance and modules such as MM (Procurement), EAM (Asset Management), HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Support the migration and validation of financial data, including balances, open items, and asset data during conversion activities
  • Assist in identifying and supporting remediation of custom code, reports, interfaces, and enhancements impacting Finance processes
  • Support Fiori application enablement, including validation of finance-related apps, roles, and user experience considerations
  • Participate in System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and defect resolution across financial and cross-functional scenarios
  • Collaborate with technical and data teams to support integration, reporting, and data reconciliation activities
  • Support cutover planning and execution, including financial readiness activities and validation of key processes
  • Provide post-go-live support and stabilization assistance for financial operations



Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

  • 3-5 years of SAP experience with a strong focus on Finance (FI) in ECC and S/4HANA environments
  • At least two full lifecycle SAP implementations, including at least one S/4HANA conversion or implementation
  • Hands-on experience with core FI modules including GL, AP, AR, and Asset Accounting
  • Functional integration experience with SAP modules including MM, EAM, HCM/Payroll, and Project Systems
  • Experience supporting financial data migration, reconciliation, and validation activities
  • Experience with SAP Fiori applications and understanding of role-based access and user experience
  • Experience supporting testing cycles including SIT and UAT in integrated SAP environments
  • Working knowledge of custom code impacts (reports, interfaces, enhancements) and ability to support functional validation
  • Experience with SAP reporting and analytics, including embedded analytics or BW-based reporting
  • Strong understanding of financial close processes, including month-end and year-end activities
  • Experience working in Agile or SAP Activate-based delivery models


Minimum Education:


  • Bachelor’s Degree – Preferred
  • Bachelor of Science or Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical/Computer Engineering or equivalent experience preferred or Accounting (preferred).



Required Certifications:


  • Certification in S/4 HANA, and/or other SAP Solutions is a plus.



Other:


  • Experience working in distributed delivery environments, including coordination with offshore or nearshore teams (e.g., LATAM delivery centers)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work directly with business stakeholders
  • Ability to support a hybrid delivery model with remote and on-site collaboration as required

title: Professor de inglês empresarial
description:
Descrição da Empresa A COMUNIK IDIOMAS oferece treinamento empresarial e acadêmico online em diversos idiomas, como inglês, alemão, espanhol, francês e português, além de serviços de tradução. Também promovemos workshops corporativos voltados para apresentações, reuniões, negociações, viagens, conferências, elaboração de currículos e preparação para entrevistas e seleções de emprego e/ou acadêmicas como testes de proficiência. Nosso diferencial é a abordagem personalizada dos idiomas, com aulas de 60 minutos com professores exclusivos e o uso de plataformas online com conteúdos balizados internacionamente onde adaptamos o aprendizado às necessidades específicas do ambiente corporativo e/ou acadêmico de cada aluno.

Descrição do Cargo: Se você é um professor curioso, dinâmico, que não se acomodou com a mesma metodologia há anos e busca inovar nas suas aulas, gosta de tecnologia, busca conteúdos atualizados na internet e usa IA de forma criativa, este anúncio é para você!

Estamos contratando Professor (es) (as) de Inglês Empresarial para ministrar aulas de forma remota. Este cargo requer proficiência em inglês, a preparação e condução de aulas personalizadas de inglês, com foco em linguagem de negócios e necessidades corporativas específicas. O dia a dia inclui, além de metodologia CEFR a adaptação de materiais (realia), aplicação de avaliações e acompanhamento do progresso dos alunos. Este é um cargo contratado com flexibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota nos horários da manhã e após 17h00.

Qualificações

  • Ensino de inglês: Experiência em ensino da língua inglesa, com foco em conversação e aptidão para ministrar aulas eficazes e acessíveis a diferentes níveis de fluência.
  • Inglês empresarial: Conhecimento específico em inglês voltado ao ambiente de negócios, incluindo terminologia, comunicação corporativa e habilidades práticas para reuniões e negociações.
  • Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos.
  • Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo.
  • Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo.
  • Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

  • Comunicação e ensino: Capacidade de se comunicar de forma clara e eficiente, além de habilidades pedagógicas para envolver e motivar os alunos.
  • Habilidades de TI: imprescindível o conhecimento de ferramentas como Google Meetings e Teams, Excel, Word, Power Point assim como o uso de AI para criação e adaptação de conteúdo.
  • Importante: formação em letras e/ou certificações de proficiência na língua inglesa e experiência no ensino remoto e flexibilidade aliada à criatividade para atender a demandas personalizadas no ambiente corporativo.
  • Diferencial: certificações no ensino de inglês como língua estrangeira (por exemplo, TEFL, CELTA).

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Java UI Application Developer
description:
Java UI Application Developer

Brazil

Senior Software Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Java UI Application developer to lead the design, development, and optimization of advanced software solutions for geophysical data processing, modeling, visualization and interpretation. In this role, you will collaborate closely with geoscientists to create innovative tools that enhance data-driven decision-making through powerful visualization and interpretation capabilities. You will also collaborate with global development teams across Europe, Canada, and the United States, contributing to a dynamic and international engineering environment.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Collaborate closely with a UX design team, product owners, and software engineers to translate UX requirements into robust GUI implementations with Eclipse RCP/SWT;
  • Present software designs and technical proposals to lead;
  • Ability to break down development tasks and lay out clear implementation roadmaps;
  • Implement and optimize computation algorithms;
  • Design and develop both thin and thick client applications that interact with cloud-based microservices;
  • Working with complex UI Java threading and concurrency;
  • Working with a large code base and multiple distributed development teams;
  • Ensure high code quality through unit testing, code reviews, security hardening and continuous integration with other domain tools;
  • Provide technical support and lead user troubleshooting sessions to resolve issues and ensure smooth operation of a complex RCP desktop application;
  • Mentor junior developers and actively contribute to architectural and implementation decisions;
  • Embrace Agile/Scrum methodologies, delivering and demonstrating working solutions at the end of each sprint;
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in computing and software development.

Essential Skills

  • BS or MS degree in computer science, Geoscience, Applied Mathematics, or a related engineering discipline;
  • Ability to break down complex development tasks and define clear, actionable implementation of roadmaps;
  • Preferred strong Java experience;
  • GitLab/Github, Eclipse RCP/SWT, VS Code, CI/CD pipelines;
  • Performance tools: VisualVM, JMC/JFR, Async;
  • Operating systems: Windows and Linux;
  • Must be self-motivated and able to work well in a distributed team environment;
  • Experience developing commercial thick client desktop applications.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Hands-on experience using Agentic AI to accelerate code implementation and enhance development productivity;
  • C++ knowledge and experience a benefit;
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms and distributed computing;
  • Restful API design and implementation;
  • AWS and Azure;
  • Tools for scalable data processing: Kubernetes, Spark;
  • Experience with Java 2D graphics or 3D OpenGL + CUDA programming;
  • Experience working with Cascading Style Sheets (CSS).

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de uma pessoa Senior Full Stack Developer com forte atuação em backend e experiência em contextos de pagamentos para compor o time de tecnologia.


Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver novas funcionalidades utilizando ReactJS e APIs RESTful, com forte atuação em backend utilizando Node.js e Express, principalmente em soluções relacionadas ao contexto de pagamentos;
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Colaborar com a equipe de tecnologia (Engenharia, Produto e Design) para o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos técnicos:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de Backend e Frontend, com maior profundidade em backend;
  • Experiência em Typescript e API REST;
  • Experiência ou vivência com integrações e contextos de pagamentos (gateways, billing, recorrência, webhooks ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Conhecimento em Styled Components e Context API;
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe e boa comunicação;
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico.


Modelo de Contratação:

PJ


Oferecemos :

Cartão flexível de benefícios.

Rotina remota de trabalho;

Ambiente de trabalho descontraído e inovador;

Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos desafiadores e com grande impacto.



Como se candidatar

Valorizamos perspectivas diversas e incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas com diferentes experiências. Se você é uma pessoa desenvolvedora sênior e está buscando uma oportunidade desafiadora em uma empresa inovadora, se candidate na oportunidade.

title: Commercial Lead — Brazil
description:
About Regrow

Regrow is a climate-tech company on a mission to make resilient agriculture the global norm. We partner with food, beverage, textile, and financial sector leaders to measure, reduce, and report on the environmental impact of their agricultural supply chains. Our platform combines agronomic science, remote sensing, and data analytics to help organizations meet their sustainability goals while supporting farmers through the transition to regenerative practices.



About the Role

As Commercial Lead in Brazil, you will drive Regrow’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets. This is a full-cycle, new-business role: you will open new accounts, build and qualify pipeline, and close enterprise deals with customers across Brazil’s agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.


You will work closely with our Head of LatAm, global go-to-market team, and customer success organization to bring Regrow’s platform to food and beverage brands, textile companies, biofuel producers, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, traders, banks, and financial institutions operating across grains, beef, and dairy value chains.


This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.



What You’ll Do

  • Own the full commercial cycle for new business in Brazil: prospecting, discovery, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Open doors with senior decision-makers and executive sponsors at strategic target accounts.
  • Build and maintain a qualified pipeline sourced exclusively from new accounts, with disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.
  • Expand Regrow’s presence in priority verticals, including CPG, textiles, biofuels, agribusiness, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, and financial institutions.
  • Position Regrow credibly within Brazil’s grains, beef, and dairy value chains, adapting our narrative to local market context.
  • Partner with global GTM, product, science, and customer success teams to shape complex deals and ensure smooth post-close transitions.
  • Provide structured market intelligence on competitive dynamics, buyer needs, adoption barriers, and regulatory signals.
  • Represent Regrow at industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



What You’ll Bring

  • Proven experience in hunting and opening new enterprise accounts in complex B2B environments.
  • Track record of closing new business and an active network that can be activated in the short term.
  • Strong presence in agribusiness with real access to decision-makers across agricultural and agro-industrial value chains.
  • Deep understanding of Brazilian agri-food ecosystems and buyers such as CPGs, traders, cooperatives, processors, meatpackers, banks, and financial institutions.
  • Experience in or strong affinity with climate tech, sustainability, regenerative agriculture, carbon footprint, MRV, traceability, or SaaS platforms.
  • Executive presence and the credibility to engage senior buyers as a commercial partner, not a transactional seller.
  • Ability to translate technical and scientific topics into clear, concrete commercial proposals.
  • Comfort operating in a matrixed environment with global teams and in dynamic, high-growth contexts.
  • Native or near-native Portuguese fluency.
  • Professional working proficiency in English, with the ability to present to and collaborate with global stakeholders regularly.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for industry conferences and client meetings across Brazil.



Nice to Have

  • Recent experience in scale-ups, startups, or high-growth technology companies.
  • Experience selling innovative categories into traditional industries.
  • Working knowledge of Spanish.



Why Regrow

  • Meaningful mission: shape the future of agriculture and help build climate resilience at scale.
  • High-growth, scale-up environment with autonomy and real ownership.
  • A collaborative global team combining commercial, scientific, and technical expertise.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits.



Acerca de Regrow

Regrow es una empresa de climate tech con la misión de convertir la agricultura resiliente en la norma global. Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Your role and responsabilities:


  • Handling major incidents via CIRS (Critical Issue Response System) and providing frequent updates until resolution.
  • Performing deep-dive application troubleshooting and identifying preventive actions.
  • Managing CIRS-related requests including deployments, feature toggles, and data fixes.
  • Following up on major production incidents and coordinating with cross-functional teams.
  • Enhancing monitoring capabilities using tools like Dynatrace, Kibana, and Splunk .
  • Writing and improving monitoring scripts and alerts based on incident learnings.
  • Handling customer escalations and coordinating with Support & Engineering teams.
  • Supporting planned activities and responding to ad-hoc requests from CES teams.


Requirements and Qualifications:


  • Deep experience in DevOps and Production Support .
  • Experience in automation and CI/CD practices.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, Kibana, Splunk .
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and ability to deep dive into application issues.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills across teams.


Please submit resumé in English.
